subject: info-ds
title: INFO.DS.-----C.CONT.
description: Second diagram on page 289, sitting between the closing fragment of CMOA(II)-47 and the start of CMOA(II)-48 (the 'adaptation cycle of creative music'). Where the first diagram on this page sets up the inversion the principle-exposure cycle produces, this one diagrams the next sequence: INFO-DS (information dissemination — how a thrust alignment actually spreads) crossed with C-CONT (composite continuance — whether the form persists through that spread). (C)INFO-DS is subject in the upper-left with the subject-arrow; C-CONT is the partner-center beside it. From C-CONT's dot, PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) runs down to the right; MT-INFO (multi-information) rises up-right from the PROJ-DY line, and TRS (transition) runs from MT-INFO to anchor the right side, with INFO-INTR (information interpretation) rising from the TRS line at the upper right margin. CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions) drops from the TRS line and fans into ALT-F (alternative functionalism) on the lower-left of the partner side and SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) on the lower-right. On the subject side, SOC-RT (social reality) drops from the main line at lower-left, T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) branches from SOC-RT to the bottom-center, and GRAD (gradualism) branches from T-C-IMP.
